node.title: Official exact-slice rate-dependent near-tail bound
node.statement: Let N=2^41, rho in {1/2,1/4,1/8,1/16}, 128<=L=log2(q)<256, and let t=t_XR be the official exact-list corridor depth. If A_b is the number of t-null b-subsets of the smooth domain, then 2 sum_{j=1}^{w_rho} A_{t+j}<2^122, where (w_1/2,w_1/4,w_1/8,w_1/16)=(15,14,13,12); complementation identifies the factor two with the corresponding upper near-tail layers. The proof combines the banked interpolation bound A_{t+j}<=binom(N,j)/binom(t+j,j), a self-contained exact-slice comparison giving t<N/128, type-class entropy lower bounds giving t>N/C_rho for C_rho=(257,316,472,760), and exact integer budget inequalities. This replaces the former rate-half-only 15-layer statement and its lower-rate scope caveat.
